activity.notes: Gustav I Eriksson (Gustav Vasa) was elected King of Sweden on 6 June 1523 and reigned until his death in 1560. ATLAS records his principal sovereign Activity from 1523 to 1560; his preceding 1521–1523 regency during the revolt against Christian II is retained only as context.

sources.title: The monarchy of Sweden — The Royal Court of Sweden
sources.citation_text: The Royal Court of Sweden lists Gustav I Eriksson (Vasa) as reigning from 1523 to 1560.

sources.title: Monarkins historia — Kungahuset
sources.citation_text: The Royal Court records Gustav Vasa's election as king on 6 June 1523 and the beginning of the Vasa era.
